beats.say: Harry Kane stunned everyone as the Ballon d'Or ceremony in London became the most chaotic ever witnessed.
Harry Kane triumphs with a historic Ballon d'Or win on Monday 26 October, claiming the ultimate football prize.
According to the BBC, the glittering evening ceremony in London lasted nearly two and a half hours in total.
Sky Sports reports that former player Gary Neville hailed Kane after the massive victory by describing him as gold.
The incredible achievement marks a major milestone for English football history across the entire continent.
